hero.headline: Investigations, labs, and projects.
hero.lede: Khalad — cybersecurity graduate focused on digital forensics, incident response, SOC operations, and hands-on security research.

paragraphs: I'm a cybersecurity graduate specializing in digital forensics and incident response. This portfolio documents projects I have built, hands-on labs I have completed, and investigations where I reconstructed activity from forensic artifacts and security logs.
My work spans Windows forensics, memory and disk analysis, log correlation, malware analysis, mobile forensics, network analysis, threat hunting, and offensive-security labs.

labs.title: Cyber Kill Chain Adversary Simulation
labs.description: End-to-end controlled security lab following the attack lifecycle from phishing and initial access through execution, defense evasion, and ransomware deployment on a designated test endpoint.

investigations.title: Live investigation — Worm.Ramnit intrusion
investigations.description: Investigated a compromised machine and correlated Prefetch, AppData, and Jumplist artifacts to reconstruct activity.

investigations.title: Cobalt Strike intrusion chain reconstruction
investigations.description: Correlated Windows Defender, PowerShell, and Sysmon logs into a sequence of attacker activity.

investigations.title: Data exfiltration — USN Journal & MFT analysis
investigations.description: Reconstructed a data-exfiltration scenario using USN Journal and MFT analysis, including identification of anti-forensic evidence.

investigations.title: BitLocker recovery via GPP cpassword decryption
investigations.description: Recovered access to a BitLocker-encrypted lab drive by analyzing Group Policy Preferences credentials.

achievements.title: Digital Forensics Workshop
achievements.description: Delivered a hands-on digital forensics workshop for university students.

achievements.title: TechHack CTF — 1st Place
achievements.description: Achieved first place in the TechHack cybersecurity CTF competition.
